answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital at risk. Each agent acting as a network vertex must lock collateral to participate, creating a financial spiral that renders mass identity generation prohibitively expensive. An attacker seeking to flood the system must exhaust their own nectar of capital, as the cost to acquire sufficient voting power scales with total network value, ensuring security remains proportional to the stake invested.
